'''Gayem Leksende''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] who worked for the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Coming from the Leksende family and said to be a son of a powerful Czerka executive, he was heading Czerka's special enforcement branch.<ref name="Timely Arrival" />

==Biography==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Gayem was assigned by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Corporation]] to stop the Republic from finding a [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7]] facility that was buried on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Since he was very intrigued by the doomsday device hidden at the facility, his superiors warned him to stay away; however he ignored their advice, planning to take the device for himself.<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found" />

In [[3643 BBY]],{{Fact}} an agent [[Fauler]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] also became interested in the facility, when several Czerka finance documents suggesting its existence came into his possession.<ref name="Timely Arrival" /> Guessing that Fauler would contact an old ex-Czerka security guard [[Grommik Kurthson]], still living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Gayem arranged to disable Grommik's [[Grommik's Residence|farm]]'s [[Perimeter sensor/Legends|perimeter sensors]] and [[Autoturret/Legends|turrets]], disguising the sabotage as a work of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]]. His plan was to trap Grommik at his farm and use him as bait to lure in his Republic foes.<ref name="Last One Out" />

However before the trap would be sprung, both [[Fauler]] and Gayem sent their forces to an abandoned [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] [[Jundland Czerka facility|compound]] in [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland]]; Fauler to retrieve old Czerka data that would help him find the main Czerka facility, Gayem - to deatroy it. As the compound was overrun with [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]], Gayem stroke a deal with their warlord, [[Shurg]], to allow Czerka personnel access to the compound's databanks in exchange for weapons and speeders. However, in the middle of negotiations with Shurg, in which Gayem himself was present only via a hololink, an associate of Fauler arrived and dispatched both Czerka and [[Shurg's Gamorrean clan|Gamorrean forces]], eventually killing Shurg and Czerka [[Unidentified Czerka security commander|security commander]], securing the data for the SIS.<ref name="Timely Arrival" />

Tracing the [[Fauler]]'s associate back to the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] [[Republic Embassy (Tatooine)|safehouse]], Gayem called the agents through their holo-terminal, introducing himself and attempting to intimidate the republicans to give out [[Kamus Orden]] to [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] and abandon the search. Soon after, Gayem contacted Fauler's associate again, when they finally paid a visit to [[Grommik Kurthson]]'s [[Grommik's Residence|farm]]. While delaying them on a holo-call from his airship, [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] above the ground, he deployed [[Czerka Assassin droids|assassin droids]] to deal with Grommik and Fauler's associate; when the droids were defeated he bombarded the farm, hoping to burry them both under ground. However, Grommik managed to reach the shelter built inside his residence, and showed Fauler's associate a back entrance to escape the farm.<ref name="Last One Out" />

Information provided by [[Grommik Kurthson|Grommik]] allowed [[Fauler]] and his team to pinpoint the location of [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7]] base in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], and Fauler's associate lead a strike team to investigate, but not before destroying a [[Czerka listening outpost|listening post]] Gayem used to spy on [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] progress.<ref name="Field Trip">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Field Trip|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> Knowing that SIS sent their forces to the facility, Gayem followed, but instead of a direct confrontation, allowed the Republic team to fight their way through swarms of fabricated mind-controlled cyberneurotic soldiers, possessed by the [[The Imprisoned One|Imprisoned One]] locked inside a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Mind prison|Mind prison]] deep inside the Czerka base. Only after the base was secured and cleared from Imprisoned One's pawns, Gayem took his chance to appear.<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found" />
{{GameLS}}
Gayem was willing to offer a large sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] if the SIS team gave him the [[Mind prison|device]], as well as promising to lift the kill order on [[Kamus Orden]]. The team refused and attempted to destroy the device which angered Gayem. He and his bodyguards engaged the SIS team and were both killed.<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the dark side option, the player, [[Fauler]]'s associate, accepts the deal and allows Gayem to have the device.<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found" />
